summary: Iteration 42: tested new admin bulk-hours endpoints (/api/hours/admin/bulk, /api/hours/admin/csv, /api/hours/admin/csv/template) plus the refactored multi-select LogHoursDialog and CsvImportDialog on /hours. 15/15 pytest cases pass and the full Playwright flow (multi-select counter, dynamic submit label, bulk-vs-single endpoint routing, CSV upload with success + error panels, member-side hidden controls) all pass end-to-end. Found and fixed a regression: GET /api/hours was returning 405 because list_hours() was missing its @api.get('/hours') decorator (probably stripped when the CSV endpoint was added). Also flagged one minor serializer gap.

minor.issue: list_hours() was missing @api.get('/hours') decorator — admin Review Queue would 405. FIXED by testing agent (small decorator addition in /app/backend/routes/hours.py).

hours_out() serializer does not surface logged_by_admin / approved_by / approved_at / imported_from_csv / csv_row fields even though they are persisted. Audit / UI 'who logged this' label will not have data to show. Recommend exposing logged_by_admin + approved_by_name from hours_out().

action_items: (Optional but recommended) Update hours_out() in /app/backend/server.py:1331 to surface logged_by_admin, approved_by_name, imported_from_csv so the UI/audit trail can distinguish admin-logged vs self-logged hours.
(Optional) Consider trimming the CSV `errors` list in the response when there are hundreds of rows (current list is unbounded up to 1000 rows).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: /app/backend/routes/hours.py line ~340 — `async def list_hours(...)` was defined directly under the CSV endpoint's `return {…}` with NO decorator. Effect: GET /api/hours returned 405 Method Not Allowed, breaking the admin Review Queue list endpoint. Added @api.get('/hours'). Please review the patch.

/app/backend/routes/hours.py:160 — `"bulk_batch_id": "bulk-" + str(uuid.uuid4())[:12] if False else None` is dead code (condition is hard-coded False) and then immediately popped on line 164. Clean up.

/app/backend/routes/hours.py CSV import: no upper-bound on `errors` returned. A 1000-row file of bad rows would produce a 1000-item array in the response. Consider capping to first 50 + a summary count.
Bulk endpoint correctly de-dupes user_ids and handles chapter-scoping for governor admins — verified via tests.
Frontend Hours.jsx dialog correctly routes 1-member → /hours/admin (single) and 2+ → /hours/admin/bulk — verified via network listener.

Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration42_bulk_hours_csv.py and pass 15/15. The Hours.jsx dialog uses a per-id checkbox list with testids hours-admin-member-checkbox-{user_id}; selecting 2+ switches the submit handler to the bulk endpoint. Watch for the hours_out() serializer minor issue (does not surface logged_by_admin) if any future test depends on that field being in API responses — query the DB directly or expose the field via hours_out().
